scenes.before: That's not what happened. We followed our policy. Maybe read it before you leave a review.

scenes.title: Want the **review reply** prompt pack?
scenes.dm: Counted! The pack with the most comments gets built first.

caption:
Same 1-star review, two replies. Everyone reading the reviews sees the second one. ⭐

The second reply comes from a short prompt: describe the review, your policy, and the tone you want, and ask for a calm, specific answer.

Own a local business? Comment REVIEWS and I'll build a pack of review-reply and local marketing prompts if enough of you ask.

The review and replies are examples.
